_note: MOCK DATA – fictional, for a student prototype

action_items.title: Require structured creditor address
action_items.description: Require Cdtr/PstlAdr/TwnNm and Ctry on ACH transfers in Country X; reject absent values with BE04.

checks.expected: The transfer is rejected with BE04

sources.text:
1. ACH-R01: Validate pacs.008 against the client message_standard; use pacs.002 for status and pacs.004 for returns.
2. ACH-R02: Enforce BANK-B amount_limit 50,000 and each client's configured batch window.
3. ACH-R07: Creditor address is mandatory above 10,000 for BANK-A and BANK-B; absence yields BE04.
4. ACH-R08: A closed creditor account yields AC04; insufficient funds yield AM04.

action_items.title: Migrate instant transfer message version
action_items.description: Activate pacs.008.001.10 validation for IPS participants in Country X.

steps: Submit the same valid IPS transfer with old and new message versions
checks.expected: The new version passes and the old version is rejected after activation

sources.text: pacs.008 customer credit transfers and pacs.002 statuses. Key elements include `<IntrBkSttlmAmt>`, `<Dbtr>`, `<DbtrAcct>`, `<Cdtr>`, `<CdtrAcct>`, `<PstlAdr>`, `<TwnNm>`, `<Ctry>` and `<EndToEndId>`.

action_items.title: Lower basic-KYC wallet limit
action_items.description: Configure the WAL basic-KYC balance limit to 500 for both client profiles.

checks.expected: The transaction is forbidden with AG01

sources.text:
1. WAL-R01: Basic-KYC balance limit is 1,000 for BANK-E and 1,500 for BANK-B before CHG-P-004 takes effect.
2. WAL-R02: A transaction forbidden for the KYC tier yields AG01.
3. WAL-R03: Validate internal API fields before mapping an external transfer to pacs.008.

action_items.title: Move cheque cut-off to 13:00
action_items.description: Configure the Country Y CHQ cut-off as 13:00.

steps: Submit a Country Y cheque at 13:01
checks.expected: The cheque is returned with TM01

sources.text:
- BANK-A: country=Country X; message_standard=pacs.008.001.08; cutoff_time=14:00; amount_limit=100000; local_rules=['Creditor address mandatory for amounts above 10,000.', 'Daily reconciliation report at 18:00.']
- BANK-C: country=Country Y; message_standard=pacs.008.001.08; cutoff_time=15:00; amount_limit=75000; local_rules=['Reject closed creditor accounts with AC04.', 'Cheques after 15:00 return TM01.']

Only clients listed above enable this module. Message standard, amount limits, enabled fields and cut-off settings are client configuration, not universal ISO rules.
